subject: Medicine
concept: Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation restores hematopoiesis using autologous or allogeneic stem cells after conditioning.

content.definition: Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation restores hematopoiesis using autologous or allogeneic stem cells after conditioning.
content.explanation: Autologous transplantation returns the patient's collected cells; allogeneic transplantation uses donor cells and can provide graft-versus-malignancy effects.
content.mechanism: Autologous transplantation returns the patient's collected cells; allogeneic transplantation uses donor cells and can provide graft-versus-malignancy effects.
content.clinical_relevance: Autologous uses the patient's own stem cells. Allogeneic uses donor stem cells. Graft-versus-host disease is an important allogeneic complication.
content.diagnosis: Diagnosis uses the appropriate clinical, laboratory, microbiologic, marrow or blood-bank studies for the suspected condition.
content.treatment: Management is disease- and patient-specific and should follow current authoritative guidance.
high_yield: Autologous uses the patient's own stem cells.
Graft-versus-host disease is an important allogeneic complication.
